quickStartSection.heading: How to create a Recurring Invoice

steps.title: Open Recurring Invoice
steps.description: Press Ctrl + G (Windows) or Cmd + G (Mac). Search Recurring Invoice and open it.

steps.title: Create new Recurring
steps.description: Click Create new Recurring. Select the customer and enter invoice details and line items.

steps.title: Set recurrence
steps.description: Choose start date, repeat option, end date or Never, and check the schedule table.

steps.title: Generate Recurring Invoice
steps.description: Click Generate Recurring Invoice. Giddh will create invoices on the scheduled dates.

features.heading: How recurring invoices and bills work
features.subHeading: Set the schedule once. Giddh creates the document on each due date.

content.heading: When to use recurring invoices and bills
content.description: Many businesses need to create the same invoice or bill repeatedly — daily, weekly, monthly, or on a specific date every month. Instead of creating it manually each time, you set up a recurring schedule in Giddh.
more_content: Define frequency, start date, and duration
Pick the day or date for generation
Giddh creates the invoice or bill on schedule
Helps avoid missing due dates

content.heading: Set repeat options
content.description: In recurring settings, select the start date. Under Repeat, choose how often the invoice should be generated — every week on a specific day, every month on a specific date, every month on a specific weekday, or a custom daily, weekly, or monthly frequency.
more_content: Every week on a specific day
Every month on a specific date
Every month on a specific weekday
Custom daily, weekly, or monthly frequency

content.heading: End date or Never
content.description: You can set an end date if the invoices should stop after a certain date. If the cycle should continue, choose Never. Giddh shows a schedule table with the dates on which invoices will be created.
more_content: Set end date to stop automatically
Choose Never for ongoing billing
Schedule table shows all upcoming dates
Review before clicking Generate Recurring Invoice

content.heading: Example: monthly maintenance fee
content.description: A company charges a client a fixed monthly fee on the 5th of every month. Instead of creating the same invoice every month, create a recurring invoice, set frequency to Monthly, select the 5th day, and define the duration. Giddh generates the invoice on the scheduled dates.
more_content: Set once for repeat monthly billing
No manual invoice each month
Manage from Customer > Recurring Invoices
Stop, resume, or delete from the three dots menu

cta.heading: Create the same invoice every month? Set it as recurring in Giddh.

faqs.question: What are recurring invoices in Giddh?
faqs.answer: Recurring invoices are created automatically on a schedule you set — daily, weekly, monthly, or on a specific date every month. You set it up once instead of creating the same invoice manually each time.

faqs.question: Does Giddh support recurring bills?
faqs.answer: Yes. Giddh supports both Recurring Invoices and Recurring Bills with the same schedule options.

faqs.question: How do I open recurring invoice in Giddh?
faqs.answer: Press Ctrl + G (Windows) or Cmd + G (Mac), search Recurring Invoice, and open the section. Or go to Customer > Recurring Invoices to manage active entries.

faqs.question: What repeat options are available?
faqs.answer: You can choose every week on a specific day, every month on a specific date, every month on a specific weekday, or a custom daily, weekly, or monthly frequency.

faqs.question: Can I set an end date?
faqs.answer: Yes. Set an end date if billing should stop. Choose Never if it should continue without an end date.

faqs.question: How do I see upcoming invoice dates?
faqs.answer: Giddh shows a schedule table with the dates on which invoices will be created based on your recurrence settings.

faqs.question: How do I stop a recurring invoice?
faqs.answer: Go to Customer > Recurring Invoices. Click the three dots next to the entry and choose stop, resume, or delete.

faqs.question: Where is the help guide for recurring bills?
faqs.answer: Giddh has help articles for recurring invoices and recurring bills at giddh.com/help.
